extensionDescription.message: Consistent company email signatures for Thunderbird – with logo, legal details, design templates and central management by IT.

intro.message: Consistent signatures for all email accounts: set company details and design once, add your personal details, apply – done.

legalNote.message: Depending on the country and legal form, business emails must include details such as registered office, register court and number, and managing directors. Please check the legal requirements.

itNote.message: The company template can be distributed centrally: via a Thunderbird policy (recommended) or as a JSON file at an address on the company network. Employees then only add their own details.

exportNote.message: Company template as JSON – e.g. place it as a file on a web server or in Nextcloud:

policyNote.message: Or add it to the Thunderbird policy (policies.json) – employees then cannot change the template:

sepNote.message: Add-ons cannot remove the “-- ” separator line before signatures. To turn it off: Thunderbird settings → General → Config Editor → set mail.identity.default.suppress_sigsep to true – or centrally via policy.

lockManaged.message: The company template is set by your IT department and cannot be changed here.

lockUrl.message: The company template is loaded centrally. To edit it, clear the central template field and click “Load template”.

contactNotFound.message: No address book entry found for $EMAIL$.

contactLoaded.message: Details taken from the address book.

logoLarge.message: The logo is quite large – a smaller image keeps emails lean.

noIdentity.message: Please select at least one email account.

urlDenied.message: Without access permission the template cannot be loaded.

urlFailed.message: Template could not be loaded – check the address and file content.
